title: Making Experiment Results Comparable through Sitewide Impact Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2611.18411v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Roblox spans many product surfaces-discovery, the virtual economy, creator tools-that differ sharply in reach and in how much the affected population contributes to any sitewide metric. A randomized experiment shows whether a treatment works for the users in its sample, but this experiment lift is not comparable across surfaces, because surfaces differ in reach and in their contribution to sitewide metrics. The quantity a strategic decision needs is a counterfactual-how much an aggregated sitewide metric (e.g., total platform play time) would move if the treatment reached 100% of its target population, which may be only part of the sitewide population, during the measurement period. We call this sitewide impact. Its scaling factor, which we call the coverage factor, combines the reach and the target population's contribution to the sitewide metric under no treatment. translated_title: 通过全站影响估计使实验结果具有可比性
translated_abstract: Roblox 涵盖许多产品界面——发现、虚拟经济、创作者工具——这些界面在覆盖范围以及受影响人群对全站指标的贡献程度上差异巨大。随机实验能够表明某种处理对其样本中的用户是否有效，但这种实验提升在不同界面之间不可比，因为各界面在覆盖范围和对全站指标的贡献上各不相同。战略决策所需的量是一个反事实量：如果处理在测量期间覆盖其目标人群的100%（该目标人群可能只是全站人群的一部分），汇总的全站指标（例如平台总游戏时长）会移动多少。我们将这一量称为全站影响。其缩放因子被称为覆盖因子，它结合了覆盖范围以及目标人群在无处理情况下对全站指标的贡献。因此，一个覆盖范围较低但其用户承载了大部分指标的界面可能……
tldr: 本文提出“全站影响”估计方法和“覆盖因子”概念，通过结合实验的目标人群覆盖范围及其对全站指标的贡献，将实验提升转化为可跨产品界面比较的战略决策指标。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "sitewide impact" estimation with a "coverage factor" that combines experiment reach and the target population's contribution to sitewide metrics, making A/B experiment results comparable across different product surfaces for strategic decision-making.
